svg.title: Choose the longest component; reject branches / 最長の連結成分を選択し、分岐は拒否
svg.desc: Left: a long unbranched connected component is selected and a disconnected short piece excluded. Middle: the longest component branches, so the composite fails rather than falling back to a shorter component. Right: collinear samples cannot define a circle.

g.text: Topology matters / つながり方を確認
SCHEMATIC / 模式図 · One decision per Composite Curve feature / 複合曲線フィーチャごとに判定
Longest chain / 最長の連続部
Branch → skip / 分岐 → スキップ
一直線上の3点 → スキップ
Branching longest component → skip / 最長成分に分岐があればスキップ
